title: Pasta with cream sauce and poultry

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with cream sauce and poultry is a classic combination of tender noodles, a velvety cream sauce, and juicy poultry meat (usually chicken or turkey). The dish is popular in restaurants for its mild flavor, creamy texture, and balanced protein‑carbohydrate ratio.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cream sauce is often made from heavy cream, butter, and Parmesan, giving it a distinctive aroma.
In Italy, flat pasta shapes such as fettuccine or tagliatelle are traditionally used because they hold the sauce well.
The dish can be adapted by swapping chicken for turkey, duck, or even rabbit.
Herbs like basil, parsley, or sage are frequently added to the sauce for extra flavor.
Some regions incorporate mushrooms such as button or porcini to boost umami.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Poultry provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D from cream
items.content: The cream sauce supplies calcium for bone health and vitamin D that aids its absorption.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Durum‑wheat pasta releases energy slowly, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both poultry and whole‑grain pasta contain B6 and B12, important for nervous system function.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Poultry provides heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant‑based iron.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Cream sauce can be calorie‑dense and contain saturated fats; portion control is advised for weight‑watchers.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Cream and butter may cause discomfort for people who are lactose intolerant.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to milk should avoid this dish.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: Prepared sauces or added cheese can raise salt content; monitor added salt.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pasta hot, topped with the cream sauce and sliced sautéed poultry. Garnish with fresh herbs, grated Parmesan, and a pinch of black pepper. The dish is eaten with a fork (and a spoon for extra sauce if desired).

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 2‑3 days. The cream sauce may separate; gently reheat and stir before serving. Freezing is possible but may alter the sauce texture, so it’s best to freeze only the pasta without the sauce.
